title: feat(plugin-security)!: the boot writes no sys_permission_set row (#15204 stage 6b-2)
body:
Part of #15204
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

Stage **6b-2**: the boot writes no `sys_permission_set` row. The declared-permission seeder, the platform-default materialization, the `permission` publish materializer, the `metadata:reloaded` re-seed and the organization-creation hook are deleted, with drift, the seed refusal diagnostics and the `managed_by` normalizer ("only delete, never fix", batch #310 item 4). This PR leaves #15204 open: stages 7a, 7b, 8, 8-post, C7b and 6c remain.

## Landing — draft until all of these land

- **Gates first, per the seat** (6110777865, 6111348289): the user-page pickers (#22865), objectui PR-3 (grant by name), stage CD (#22881) and objectui PR-4 (the clone client). This PR does not wait for them to build.
- **Then land back to back: T1 (#22897) → T2 (#22898) → this PR.** T1 and T2 stay drafts until then, so the publish materializer and the seeders are never live on `main` with their pins gone. 6b-2a (#22899: `os meta resync` and the example binders, Tier H) is independent and goes to the maintainer separately.
- **Size.** T1 and T2 (and 6b-2a) were split off so this diff falls under 3,000 lines. This branch carries their bytes. Measured residual once all three are on `main`: **2,994 changed lines** (34 files, +439 / −2,555). That is close to the line, so any growth here needs re-measuring. Until then GitHub shows the whole branch.
- **Merge notes for when `main` is merged in after the precursors:**
  - `inert-wirings.test.ts` and `schema-migrate.lazy-driver-import.test.ts` conflict with #22899's later comment fixes; take #22899's side.
  - `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`: regenerate with `node scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs --write`.
  - The two `*.baseline.json` ledgers: drop every entry for a deleted suite.
- **Tier H** while the 6b-2a content rides here (`skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md`). After #22899 lands and `main` is merged, this diff touches no governed path, and size alone decides the terminal.

## What changes

| Surface | Before | Now |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `bootstrap-declared-permissions.ts` (522 lines) | seeded every declared set as a `managed_by:'package'` row, once per organization under a wall | deleted |
| `bootstrap-platform-admin.ts` | seeded the platform defaults insert-once; `resync` reconciled them | writes no catalog row. It reads the legacy `admin_full_access` row only for leg C (a grant written before the name column; restrict-only). A refused read withholds the promotion and says so once. No `resync` option, no `seeded` / `resynced` / `resyncSkipped` |
| `permission` publish materializer (SP) | upserted a package-door publish into a row; ran the suggestion reconcile and `everyone`'s re-derivation only when it materialized and the body carried `isDefault` | deleted. The reconcile and the re-derivation hang off `onMetadataMutation`: every landed `permission` publish, direct save or delete, unconditionally. Drafts and other types do nothing (closes U2 contract flag A, 6109964380) |
| `metadata:reloaded` re-seed, organization-creation hook (SP) | re-seeded rows after a hot install and per new organization | deleted |
| `permission-set-drift.ts`, `normalize-managed-by.ts`, `seed-refusal-diagnostics.ts` | boot diagnostics over the seeded rows | deleted; their public exports go (listed in the changeset) |
| `warnOrganizationLessRows`, `catalogIsPerOrganization`, `listSeedOrganizationIds` (`organization-scope.ts`, internal) | the per-organization sweep and the organization-less row guard; the seeder was their one caller | deleted (re-measured: no live caller, no test) |
| `sys_permission_set.drift_status` / `drift_detail` and the **Needs Attention** view | written by drift | removed with their writer (translations regenerated). The packaged-overlay report still names a shadowed set at boot |
| `readDeclared` | exported by the seeder | re-homed into `declared-capability-context.ts` (its two readers: the capability context and the managed-object write denies). It is a read of the registry, the catalog's one home, never of a row, so not a transition piece. `createSecurityCatalogReader` does not fit: it refuses the `object` type, and switching the capability read to it would change a fail-closed answer into a throw on the ADR-0090 D5 gate |

## Who still needed the rows: measured, and answered before this stage

Every grant writer and the user-page grant picker write the name since 6b-2-pre (#22863). The remaining row readers on this head:
- The restrict-only legacy reaches (the leg-C id read, org-admin revoke, uninstall sweep). An existing database keeps its rows until C7b.
- Setup's grant picker still **lists** rows. A fresh database now lists none there. That is the #22865 gate above.
- 7a's projector and write-through (data-door edits of existing rows). 7a deletes them.

## Pins

- `builtin-positions.boot.test.ts` (real plugin boot, real SQLite, every scenario): **zero `sys_permission_set` rows** after boot, with a positive census control. The first platform administrator (`single`) and the organization administrator are still granted. The grant golden is unchanged, with no row at all.
- `grant-permission-set-name.writers.test.ts`: the promotion leaves zero rows and the holder reads by name. The 6b-2-pre pins stay green: organization admins under a wall and under `single` on zero rows; self-registration and the verify persona in their packages.
- `everyone-rederivation-on-permission-mutation.test.ts`: one listener even across a bootstrap re-run. Publish and delete of a `permission` re-derive; a draft or another type does not.
- U2's `suggested-binding-acceptance.dogfood.test.ts` stays green.
- `showcase-permission-seeding.dogfood.test.ts` (the `declarative-permission-seeding` authz row, rewritten): the showcase's sets are served by the catalog with their package, and the boot writes no row.
- `bootstrap-platform-admin-refused-existence-read.test.ts`: a refused legacy read withholds the promotion and writes nothing; an empty answer goes on.

## Also in this PR

- **Liveness ledger.** `permission.packageId` re-points to its surviving reader (the CLI's compile-time collision door). `permission.managedBy` is corrected to `dead`: the retired seeder stamped the column and never read the authored key, so the old `live` verdict was already wrong (see Acceptance notes).
- **Tenant-audit census** regenerated: the normalizer's two write sites leave, 232 → 230. The hand-written figures on `tenant-audit-census.mdx` are updated.
- **Docs**: `permission-sets.mdx` (built-in sets, provenance, the drift section reduced to overlay shadow) and `authorization.mdx`.
- **Test fixtures** that model an existing database write the legacy platform-bucket rows themselves (`__tests__/legacy-catalog-rows.testkit.ts`, dogfood `ensureLegacyPermissionSetRow`).
- **Gate ledgers**: the double-contract ledgers drop the retired suites and pin the new one.

## Changesets

- `@objectstack/plugin-security` **minor**, BREAKING, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.
- 6b-2a's own file (`@objectstack/cli` minor BREAKING; `plugin-security`, `driver-sql`, `runtime` patch) rides here until it lands.

## Verification (local, at the head this PR opens with)

- Build: `turbo run build`, 74/74.
- plugin-security full: 189 files, 3,884 passed (45 skipped).
- cli unit tier: 282 files, 4,233 passed.
- example-crm and example-showcase: green.
- Typecheck green: plugin-security, cli, dogfood, example-crm, example-showcase.
- Dogfood, **in full**: 248 files passed, 1 skipped; 2,009 tests passed, 9 skipped (U2's acceptance pin included).
- The census pins (`authz-conformance`, `authz-probe-blind-spot`) are in that run.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 134 derived families, all run, each recorded with its exit code; reconciled by `--ran`, 0 not measured. Red: `check:platform-checklist` only, with the same 8 absent-symbol anchors on T1 (which touches no checklist file), so they come from `main`.

## Acceptance notes

- **`permission.managedBy` is an authored key with no reader** (pre-existing; the ledger now says `dead`). Retiring it is an enforce-or-remove item for the spec seat. It is not done here.
- **The name-fold census instrument** (`scripts/measure-position-name-fold-census.mjs`, not a CI gate) refuses to report once 6b-2a deletes the binders: its controls read binder tuples. Carrier: whoever next runs it re-aims its junction scan at `PositionSchema.permissionSets`.
- **Two dogfood suites** (`two-doors-permission`, `showcase-permission-projection`) keep their data-door cases on an existing database (the fixture writes the legacy row), because the gate still guards such rows until 7a / stage 8. 块1 (a publish materializes a row) is deleted with the materializer.
- `check:platform-checklist` reds on `main` (anonymous-form-intake and other symbol anchors) are pre-existing and outside this diff.

## 维护者速读（草稿）

**改了什么**：启动过程不再向 `sys_permission_set` 表写任何行。删除了：包声明权限集的播种器、平台默认权限集的物化（含 `os meta resync` 命令，见 6b-2a）、包发布时的物化器、热安装后的重播种、新建组织时的播种，以及基于这些行的漂移诊断、`managed_by` 归一化和播种拒绝诊断。`sys_permission_set` 上的 `drift_status`/`drift_detail` 两个字段及「需要关注」视图随写入者一并删除。U2 的「接受包默认权限集后重新推导 everyone」从被删的发布物化器挪到元数据变更信号上，且改为对每次权限集发布/保存/删除都执行（不再要求请求体带 `isDefault`）。

**为什么改**：ADR-0131 D3 规定权限集只有一个家——注册表。鉴权解析器从阶段 1 起已从注册表读定义，授权从 6b-2-pre 起按名称写入，这些行已不再决定任何权限。

**风险与代价（含回滚）**：全新数据库上 Setup 的「授予权限集」选择器仍列表行，因此会是空的——这就是本 PR 等 #22865 选择器决定再合并的原因。已有数据库保留旧行（直到 C7b）。删除了若干公开导出和 `bootstrapPlatformAdmin` 的 `resync` 选项，changeset 已逐项列出。回滚：直接 revert，无数据迁移。本 PR 需先合入 T1、T2、6b-2a 三个前置 PR，之后合并 main，差异约 2,870 行。

**席位意见**：

**你要做的**：等 #22865、objectui PR-3、CD（#22881）、objectui PR-4 落地后批准合并；在 6b-2a 落地前，本 PR 因含 skills 文件为 Tier H。
